title: Add scope-guard running-line watcher: flags, pauses, status display
summary: After each attempt of a line of work, evaluate T1–T5 (already built in scope_guard.rs). Record flags and pauses (with signal, numbers, and lift condition), show them in `athena status`, and make dispatch and `athena retry` refuse a paused line with the pause reason. The audience is the owner running Athena, who needs thrashing lines stopped without any process being killed.

defaults_applied.how: Behavior tests for pause and flag, plus clippy and fmt.
Criteria check dispatch refusal and status output.
One focused change over the listed files.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Job 20261026-015416-94rc has landed, so scope_guard.rs already has the signal functions and evaluate_before_attempt.
Pause records are stored with the existing job-record mechanism; the exact form is chosen by the producer from existing records code.
Rules only: no value scoring or model scorer.

acceptance_criteria.text: A test with two rejections on the same unmet criterion shows the third attempt is not dispatched and a pause record exists; run `cargo test`.
A test with rejections on differing criteria records a flag only: no pause record, and the next attempt is dispatched; run `cargo test`.
A test shows `athena retry` on a paused line refuses with the pause reason; run `cargo test`.
A test shows the status output lists flagged and paused lines with their signal (T1–T5); run `cargo test`.
A pause record names the signal, the numbers that tripped it, and what would lift it (a measurement, or a narrowed request for T4).
Pauses never kill a running job; they only stop the next dispatch. CHANGELOG.md has an entry for the watcher.
`cargo clippy` is clean and `cargo fmt --check` passes.

out_of_scope: Value scoring and the model scorer
departures: Touches the run loop, status, and CLI display, so it is larger than the typical job.
